title: Passing a measure inequality from compactly contained open neighbourhoods to a compact set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, E ⊆ U compact, μ and ν measures on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and c ∈ [0, ∞]. Suppose μ(G) ≤ ν(G) + c for every open G ⊇ E such that closure(G) is compact and contained in U. Then μ(E) ≤ ν(E) + c.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsCompact E → E ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → E ⊆ G → CompactlyContained G U → μ G ≤ ν G + c) → μ E ≤ ν E + c
